name: board-flow
description: Adds a single atlassian-expert worker plus Jira-aware slash commands (configure, capture, plan-track-build-validate, execute, fix, drain, triage, prove, prove-drain, advance) on top of any topology that ships planning-lead, engineering-lead, and validation-lead subagents — or any topology with a custom lifecycle declared in board-flow.yaml (project root, used by /advance). /execute auto-routes Bug cards to /fix (reproduce-fix-verify); use --force-feature-flow to override. /triage grooms the backlog — classifies each card (already-implemented → In Review, ready → To Do, obsolete → Won't Do, needs-decision → grills you) by inspecting the codebase + git for evidence, writing nothing until you confirm. /prove + /prove-drain run the change-driven proof gate (via the topology's proof-reviewer) to triage the Review column by evidence. Scope the *-drain sweeps to a board slice via a raw-JQL scope block in board-flow.yaml (per-command and per-topology overrides, plus --scope/--no-scope per run); single-card commands warn when a named card is out of scope. Run /board-flow:configure once after install to set site/project/board. Tested with build-hex, build-team, and discovery. Won't work with build-solo for the lead-based commands.
